about: The Elektron Digitone's envelope and LFO fade times, measured on the owner's unit (OS 1.44, 2026-10-14, recorded losslessly over USB at 48 kHz: tools/digitone/dt_measure.py runs 1 and 2, analysed by dt_analyse.py). Derived numbers only (no audio). Per envelope: the measure, the setup (Digitone values), per value the seconds (s: run 1 and 2 merged as summary.py merges: the mean of the measured runs, else of the extrapolated), extrapolated, and each run's own numbers. Run 1 sent HARM coarse 64 (+1.00), not 0.00: its filter and operator A captures differ from run 2's. The proxy envelopes (filter, operators) are readings of the spectral centroid, not envelope times: FM TONE is calibrated through the same reading (make_quad_times.py --calibrate).

amp_attack.about: the full linear rise (t90 - t10) / 0.8 of the amplitude envelope
amp_attack.setup: ALGO 1, MIX -64 (C alone, a plain sine), A LEV 0, B LEV 0, filter OFF, C4 velocity 100; decay: SUS 0

grid.about: from 112 up every measured full rise is an integer multiple of one unit (fitted: unit_s); the values between are interpolated on the multiples (113 = 3.5, 115 = 5, 117 = 8, 119 = 14, 121 = 24, 123 = 36)
